maddeler.e:
ننقلع (form VII)
# نَنْقَلِعُ (nanqaliʕu) /nan.qa.li.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْقَلَعَ (inqalaʕa)
# نَنْقَلِعَ (nanqaliʕa) /nan.qa.li.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْقَلَعَ (inqalaʕa)
# نَنْقَلِعْ (nanqaliʕ) /nan.qa.liʕ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْقَلَعَ (inqalaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
